FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Rest Funeral Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Eternal Rest Funeral Services provides compassionate and professional funeral and cemetery services, ensuring a dignified farewell for loved ones. Our operations include arranging personalized memorial services, managing burial and cremation processes, and maintaining serene cemetery grounds. We are committed to compliance with all local and state regulations, and we prioritize the safety and sanitation of our facilities and services. Our trained staff is dedicated to supporting families during their time of need, with offerings that reflect respect and understanding for each individual's wishes. Additionally, we uphold rigorous standards for vendor management, ensuring all partners meet our certification requirements to provide the highest quality service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred on 06/15/2022 due to a server failure resulting in the temporary loss of client records, amounting to $2,500. Status resolved with data restoration completed. Additionally, on 07/10/2022, two gravestones were inadvertently damaged during a landscaping project, resulting in a loss of $2,500. Status currently under review for restoration options.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 5 PM; Saturday: 9 AM - 2 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: U.S. Standard Burial Vault, Class 1, Approved
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Well-maintained perimeter fencing and security cameras, with a dedicated watchperson present during operational hours to ensure safety and deter unauthorized access.

reviews: Eternal Rest Funeral Services provided exceptional care during a difficult time. Their staff was compassionate and attentive to our family's needs.
The facilities are beautifully maintained, and the team was very professional. They made the process of planning a memorial service much easier.
I appreciated the personalized attention we received. They truly understand how to support families in their time of grief.
The service was respectful and dignified. I felt that my loved one was in good hands throughout the entire process.
Eternal Rest exceeded our expectations with their thoughtful approach and attention to detail. Highly recommend for anyone in need of funeral services.
